description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to appoint Prof. Uma Coomaraswamy to be the Competent Authority of the Easterm University, Sri Lanka w.e.f. 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the appointment of a Competent Authority for a university under the Universities Act. While it names a Minister (Lakshman Kiriella) and an appointee (Professor Uma Coomaraswamy), the core subject matter is an educational/administrative action specific to a university, not a change in government structure, personnel, or ministerial portfolios. This falls under "Educational matters and academic appointments" as specified in the Miscellaneous (Type 10) category.
